name: Stan
description: Creator storefront / “make a living online” platform (stan.store) — link-in-bio commerce for digital products and services.

mentions.evidence: ~$3.57M MRR, ~101.6k active subscriptions, ~$2.84M L30, ~$76.6M all-time. Stripe API key expired; data last updated Apr 20, 2026 — treat as last verified snapshot, not live.
mentions.indieAngle: Proof that a simple creator checkout layer can out-earn almost every “AI wrapper” on the leaderboard.

whyItPrints: Takes a cut of creator checkouts at massive scale. Not glamorous infra — just the cash register creators already need.
whyThisMatters:
Creators use Stan as the store on their link in bio. Courses, digital products, and bookings sit in that one place, so a follower can pay without jumping to another app. You don't write any code. They say you can put the store up in a few minutes. Checkout is a single tap. It also connects to the other tools a creator already uses.

Business coaches use it. So do social-media coaches, fitness coaches, spirituality creators, and real-estate coaches. Some of those examples have followings from around 100,000 people into the millions. The audience is already there. Stan is where the course, the file, or the call gets paid for.

The pitch is that you stop paying for a handful of separate selling apps. One link hosts the courses, the files, and the call bookings together. A coaching session and a download can share that same checkout. Stan takes a cut when a follower checks out. Stripe access on the listing ran out in April 2026, so the big monthly number dates from then.
